channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mac
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: lmux — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight terminal built on libghostty for running Claude Code and Codex sessions, with agent status in the sidebar.

item.title: camber — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Arc-style browser on Chromium (Electron) with spaces, pinned tabs, folders, a command bar and Arc import.

item.title: TinyRecorder — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight screen recorder for screens, windows, apps, system audio and a connected iPhone or iPad; a maintained fork of QuickRecorder.

item.title: Stage Manager — via awesome-mac
item.description: Replacement for Apple's Stage Manager written in Rust, with stages that survive restart and Ctrl-Option-1..9 switching.

item.title: NVBeacon — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar app for monitoring remote NVIDIA GPU servers over SSH.

item.title: Leafy — via awesome-mac
item.description: Look up any word on screen with ⌥A, including in PDFs and images, and save it to a searchable local library.

item.title: Graphis — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app that generates images from text with the MOSS-Image model, locally on Apple silicon.

item.title: Convoy — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source download manager with segmented downloads, browser integration, and HLS and DASH stream support.

item.title: Buddy — via awesome-mac
item.description: Study helper in the notch that explains what is on your screen out loud while drawing on it.

item.title: AllInOneIME — via awesome-mac
item.description: Input method that adds AI commands such as @improve, @translate and @question to every text field, with built-in pinyin input.

item.title: Wavo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Dictation that doesn't slow your Mac down: it runs on the Neural Engine, keeps your voice off the cloud, and types what you say wherever you're typing.

item.title: Saywing — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool that reads selected screen regions aloud using local OCR and neural speech, with offline English and German dictation.

item.title: Roar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source agentic browser that uses local or bring-your-own AI models to navigate, read and fill the web for you.

item.title: Radif — via awesome-mac
item.description: Unofficial open-source YouTube Music client built with Tauri, with synced lyrics and a video mode, that needs YouTube Music Premium.

item.title: Leafy — via awesome-mac
item.description: Look up any word on screen with ⌥A, including in PDFs and images, and save it to a searchable local library.

item.title: Koru — via awesome-mac
item.description: Offline-first, open-source workspace for notes and docs with end-to-end encrypted device-to-device sync, built in Rust.

item.title: Flipic — via awesome-mac
item.description: Photo culling viewer: arrow-key paging through a folder, 100% focus check, XMP ratings that Lightroom and Capture One read, on-device cleanup mode.

item.title: Drifting — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source, local-first novel writing app with chapters, outline, characters and storylines, and an AI agent that can read and edit the whole project.

item.title: Vortex — via awesome-mac

item.title: Tingo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source meeting notes app that records any call, transcribes it and tells speakers apart on device, and writes minutes whose every point links back to the original audio, using the LLM you choose.

item.title: TimeMachineEjector — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that ejects your Time Machine backup disk when a backup finishes and mounts it again when a scheduled backup is due.

item.title: Switch — via awesome-mac
item.description: Keyboard window switcher that lists every open window across Spaces and filters as you type.

item.title: SSHTermaq — via awesome-mac

item.title: RefreshYourMac — via awesome-mac
item.description: Mac cleaner that rates every category Safe to Remove, Review, Move to Backup or Protected, and shows what left it behind before anything is deleted.

item.title: Murmury — via awesome-mac

item.title: MP4Flow — via awesome-mac

item.title: LumaRing — via awesome-mac

item.title: Ferrocast — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fast keyboard launcher written in Rust, with clipboard history, snippets, window management and 275 local file conversions.

item.title: Carbon — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that transcribes meetings on device and saves each one as a Markdown file, with no bot and no cloud.

item.title: Breaker — via awesome-mac
item.description: Watches the launchd jobs, cron jobs, Folder Actions, and SwiftBar plugins you set up yourself and notifies you when one breaks.

item.title: AI Footprint — via awesome-mac

item.title: Sidekey — via awesome-mac

item.title: Shutterbar — via awesome-mac
item.description: ShareX-style screenshots with ⌘C-to-clipboard, after-capture tasks, last-region recapture and scrolling capture.

item.title: ShotMap — via awesome-mac
item.description: Turn videos into storyboard images with smart frame selection, manual refinement, and local PNG/JPG export.

item.title: ShinyMac — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source SwiftUI Mac cleaner with one-scan Smart Care, an app uninstaller that finds leftovers, Xcode cleanup, a Space Lens disk map and hidden settings.

item.title: NTFSTool — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free, open-source NTFS read and write for Mac, with no kernel extension.

item.title: LumaView — via awesome-mac
item.description: Minimal native image viewer for browsing folders, inspecting EXIF metadata, and reading multipage PDFs.

item.title: Coincide — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source native workspace for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity), where one thread can switch agents mid-conversation.

item.title: Tarn — via awesome-mac

item.title: NeatEditor — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fast, native macOS plain-text editor for distraction-free writing.

item.title: MacResourceMonitor — via awesome-mac

item.title: Mac TV — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Apple TV-style home screen for streaming apps, with a phone remote and a local movie player.
